bearerAuth.description: An API key (ms_live_...), an MCP OAuth access token, or the admin token

hash.description: sha256 of the rows in the form python's Benchmark.version hashes them

version.description: The dataset version that wrote this row as it is now

requestHash.description: sha256 prefix of the request messages; the messages themselves are not stored

answeredBy.description: The model whose answer the caller received

key.description: The full key, shown once; it starts with ms_live_

estimate.description: The point estimate the checked value was read from

low.description: Lower end of the estimate's 95% interval

high.description: Upper end of the estimate's 95% interval

measured.description: False when the check was recorded at a failing worst-case value

reason.description: Why the check was not measured

changes.description: Cases that improved or regressed against the baseline run, for the case score and each paired metric; null without a baseline

paired.description: True when both runs logged this metric per case, so the difference has a paired interval

improved.description: Cases whose value went up against the baseline; null when not paired

regressed.description: Cases whose value went down against the baseline; null when not paired

metrics.description: Both runs' values for every paired metric

signTest.description: Exact two-sided sign test of fixed against broken
